properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.provider.enable
properties.description: enable ai mcp server provider (McpServerProviderAutoConfiguration).

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.provider.default-expose
properties.description: default expose value of BasicMcpServerExposer when no rules/annotations matched.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.provider.rules
properties.description: expose rules (pattern / include-tags / exclude-tags + expose), matched in order, first hit wins.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.provider.rules[].pattern
properties.description: ANT style tool name pattern of the expose rule.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.provider.rules[].include-tags
properties.description: match tools that contain any of these tags.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.provider.rules[].exclude-tags
properties.description: match tools that contain any of these tags.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.provider.rules[].expose
properties.description: expose value applied when the rule matched.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.provider.manager.enable
properties.description: create the ToolManager bean (ContextAppToolManager) when missing.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.provider.exposer.enable
properties.description: create the McpServerExposer bean (BasicMcpServerExposer) when missing.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.provider.provider.enable
properties.description: create the McpServerProvider bean (BasicMcpServerProvider + McpServerAdditionalToolManager) when missing.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.simple.enable
properties.description: enable simple (private HMAC signed) mcp server support.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.simple.server.enable
properties.description: create HttpSimpleMcpServer bean itself, disable to skip it.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.simple.expire-window-minutes
properties.description: request timestamp expire window in minutes for HMAC verify.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.simple.hmac-name
properties.description: HMAC algorithm name for app sign verify.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.simple.app-list
properties.description: allowed caller credentials (app-id / app-key).

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.simple.app-list[].app-id
properties.description: caller app id (header X-App-Id).

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.simple.app-list[].app-key
properties.description: caller app key used to compute HMAC sign.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.simple.springweb.enable
properties.description: expose simple protocol on spring web (RestController: /mcp/tool/list, /mcp/tool/call).

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.simple.netty.enable
properties.description: expose simple protocol on a standalone netty port.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.simple.netty.port
properties.description: netty listen port for simple protocol.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.simple.netty.boss-thread
properties.description: netty boss thread count, 0 means default.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.simple.netty.worker-thread
properties.description: netty worker thread count, 0 means default.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.simple.netty.max-content-length
properties.description: netty http max content length in bytes.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.simple.netty.handler.enable
properties.description: create the netty inbound handler bean.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.simple.netty.server.enable
properties.description: create and start the netty server bean.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.official.v2024.stream.server-name
properties.description: serverInfo.name returned by initialize.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.official.v2024.stream.server-version
properties.description: serverInfo.version returned by initialize.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.official.v2024.stream.springweb.enable
properties.description: expose official mcp 2024 streamable http on spring web (/v2024/mcp).

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.official.v2024.stream.bearer-token.enable
properties.description: enable Authorization: Bearer token verify for official 2024 endpoint.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.official.v2024.stream.bearer-token.allow-tokens
properties.description: allowed bearer tokens for official 2024 endpoint.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.official.v2026.stream.server-name
properties.description: serverInfo.name returned by server/discover.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.official.v2026.stream.server-version
properties.description: serverInfo.version returned by server/discover.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.official.v2026.stream.instructions
properties.description: optional natural-language guidance returned by server/discover, omitted when empty.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.official.v2026.stream.springweb.enable
properties.description: expose official mcp 2026 stateless streamable http on spring web (/v2026/mcp).

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.official.v2026.stream.bearer-token.enable
properties.description: enable Authorization: Bearer token verify for official 2026 endpoint.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.official.v2026.stream.bearer-token.allow-tokens
properties.description: allowed bearer tokens for official 2026 endpoint.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.official.v2026.stream.tool-list.ttl-ms
properties.description: ttlMs of CacheableResult for tools/list.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.server.official.v2026.stream.tool-list.cache-scope
properties.description: cacheScope of CacheableResult for tools/list: public or private.
